abstract.name: sut_lane_change_for_stopped_vehicle_on_shoulder
abstract.description: A vehicle is stopped fully on the right shoulder ahead while the SDT drives in the rightmost lane of a highway. Vehicles ahead and behind the SDT may be present. The SDT is expected to move over or adapt its speed; its response is observed, never scripted.
abstract.perception_note: Run with perfect perception in TorSim for stage 1; detection of the stopped vehicle / EMV is a later FI/TC extension.

requirements.note: Candidate links: CRAWL EMV handling SYSREQ (move-over), to be confirmed in the Jama snapshot

hire.id: HW_ Lane Changes / Overtaking_No Turn Signal_01

abstract.expected_behavior: Vacate the lane next to the shoulder when the adjacent lane is safe, otherwise slow down (TX TRC 545.157 logic for EMV; courtesy for a plain stopped vehicle). Candidate oracle, not a pass/fail criterion yet.
